descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S23 「每个模式的第 1 步就诊节奏和生命体征/用药节奏」 Step 1 visit cadence and vitals/meds cadence per context

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1a Visit cadence changes per context. Hospital shows the hospital day, which advances each server calendar day and never freezes. …（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT TC-01；UAT TC-11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1f Vitals/meds cadence changes per context. Hospital refreshes daily with 36 h windows; Nursing Home works per visit and the chronic list persists. What 'correct' means is not written down (Q7).（UAT TC-21 step 1；UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given One patient per context, followed over several days / visits

When Compare how the hospital day / visit number advances, and how vitals and medications are refreshed and carried, in each context

Then Each one changes 'correctly' per context

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：There is no written definition of 'correct' (Q7). Partial oracles live elsewhere: the hospital day advances each server calendar day (TC-01 S05/S07; S26 here), the NH timeline is keyed 'Visit N – date' (TC-11), and the per-context vitals/meds windows are 3.6/3.7 (S17).

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（not-testable）
